scope: HBQ queue back-off, jam pair/replan and push/rear-clear helpers; scoped branch review only

fn_driveAssist.sqf: 1383-1533 release, back-up, cascade, replan and jam latch

findings.evidence: JamReal requires both observed vehicles to have stood for more than five seconds, then latches the pair until its role ends. Yield/pass roles use ranks and finite deadlines.
findings.disposition: Retain persistence and asymmetric responsibility intent. WAIT still needs a real multi-owner jam operation; ordinary following or pass consent alone is insufficient.

findings.evidence: JamBack seeks rear clearance before a 5m/2.2s or 2m/1.2s push. If unavailable, it sets HBQAD_BackReq=time publicly on the nearest live crewed rear vehicle. Consumers honour a request younger than six seconds and retain a four-second making-room hold.
findings.disposition: Redesign as bounded, authenticated owner consent with explicit requester, participant, route/seat/epoch receipts, fixed expiry and cycle/depth limits. Public timestamp freshness does not establish requester authority. Do not copy the request protocol.

findings.evidence: JamBack clears its making-room delay if the current front vehicle exceeds 2km/h. MovingBehind vetoes reversing into traffic observed moving faster than 2km/h in the rear sector.
findings.disposition: Useful intent for a native reverse leg: stop making room when the dependency clears, with fresh rear safety throughout execution. This does not prove continuous collision safety.

findings.evidence: fn_push installs one machine EachFrame handler and repeatedly writes model-space velocity; lateral pushes also zero model-space yaw. It retains forward motion on release and checks short contact rays while active.
findings.disposition: Reject forced-velocity and lateral/yaw shortcuts for natural WAIT recovery. A replacement must obtain native reverse/steering execution and observe physical progress. Current tracked combat withdrawal is a separate intent and cannot be relabelled as general convoy jam recovery.

findings.evidence: JamReplan excludes follower/player-led/young orders, checks routeWaiting, and permits at most three retries at twenty-second intervals until progress changes. TrafficStep can temporarily relax a hard hold for 1.5s after replan and suppress non-hard holds for ten seconds after a fifteen-second hold.
findings.disposition: Preserve finite retry and authored-wait intent. Reject unconditional traffic-ignore windows as WAIT safety authority. New native-route retries require unchanged authored metadata and current movement ownership; live geometric exclusions remain effective.

findings.evidence: TrafficStep has an early _Convoy exit, but fn_driveAssist initializes _Convoy=false and the inspected source has no other assignment. Main-loop _Follower handling is separate.
findings.disposition: Do not infer active convoy integration from this guard or its comments. WAIT convoy spacing remains its own controller. Whole follower/TrafficCap behaviour needs further comparison.

findings.evidence: DrivingOperationStep and ConvoyOperationStep derive phases from current owner-local state. CortexVehicleReverseStep serves generation-bound tracked VEHICLE_WITHDRAW and explicitly refuses active convoys. DrivingPassAgreementServer brokers finite pass consent only.
findings.disposition: Keep the gap explicit: no general authenticated queue-cascade executor exists. Reuse authority patterns only after defining native motion capability, refusal, cleanup and restoration for the new intent.

implementationRequirements: One finite episode with a fixed original expiry and bounded participant count/depth. A repeated request must not renew it.
Each actual vehicle/crew owner authenticates its own consent and checks native route, seat, epoch, simulation, player/Zeus/specialist authority and intentional waits.
Rear-most eligible participant moves first only after fresh bounded hull/actor clearance. Cycles, refusal, stale ownership or unknown space end admission without pushing another actor.
Use existing sole movement/speed writers and native driving commands. Native reverse capability for each vehicle class must be demonstrated before enabling the operation.
Observe physical displacement and separation. Forward release, newer orders, casualties, ownership change and expiry terminate only owned work.
Keep obstruction safety active during replan and release. Preserve original route conditions, synchronisation and terminal failure evidence.

After audits resume: separated normal/HC cases for stopped queues, moving rear traffic, closed rear space, opposing/crossing traffic, hostile/uncontrolled peers, cycles, expired messages, Zeus replacement and interrupted recovery. Measure overhead.
remaining: Complete TrafficCap sensing/classification branch and all corresponding priority interactions
Complete source follower/order handling and cadence comparison
Native wheeled and convoy reverse capability and finite operation implementation
Physical multi-owner jam/queue outcomes and performance

preparedCapabilityFixture.scope: Normal-owner excluded native diagnostic only; separate tracked APC, wheeled MRAP and truck, each LEFT/RIGHT.
preparedCapabilityFixture.requirements: At least three backward-velocity samples, one metre displacement, three degrees heading change, observed yaw sign and bounded turning observer execution.
